defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It returns the first input edge having a common neighbor, rather than comparing all valid triples against the required lexicographic minimum.

Its shown approach iterates through input edges and sorted adjacency data, but does not show a global lexicographic-best comparison; it is therefore vulnerable to returning an earlier non-minimal triangle.

recommended_edit: Replace the unconditional triangle-existence guarantee with an explicit no-solution case and require `0 0 0` when no three-person deadlock exists.
